annotations.title: Open a video service on the TV

description: Open an episode, a cartoon, a film, a music video or a channel in the TV's own app for that service: YouTube, YouTube Kids, Rutube, VK Video, Kinopoisk, ivi, Okko, Wink, START, PREMIER, KION, more.tv, Smotrim, MEGOGO, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Max, Apple TV, Twitch, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Crunchyroll, Pluto TV, Tubi. Find the official link with web search first (in the TV's language, see tv_status). The service's app then plays it (TeleQ leaves the screen; the user returns with Back/Home). Official sources only.

start_s.description: Optional (YouTube): start this many seconds in.

title.description: Optional title, for the notice on the TV (up to 120 characters).

url.description: https:// link to the video, episode, series, playlist or channel page on one of the listed services (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=…, https://rutube.ru/video/…/).
